description: Magento 2 / Mage-OS module (Digitalway_SocialLogin) to sign in or register with Google, Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram via OAuth2, with no external Composer dependencies. Buttons on the login, registration and checkout sign-in pages; social identities linked to customers in a website-scoped table.
rules: Install with composer config repositories.social-login vcs https://github.com/mage-os-lab/module-social-login, then composer require digitalway/module-social-login and bin/magento setup:upgrade.

Configure in Stores → Configuration → Customers → Social Login; configuration paths start with digitalway_sociallogin/ (general/enabled, then <provider>/enabled, <provider>/client_id, <provider>/client_secret).
The redirect URI to register in each provider console is https://<domain>/sociallogin/account/callback/provider/<google|facebook|linkedin|instagram>/.
Providers are registered in Digitalway\SocialLogin\Model\ProviderPool via di.xml; the item name is the provider code used in URLs, configuration and the digitalway_social_identity table.

A provider implements Digitalway\SocialLogin\Api\ProviderInterface (usually by extending Model\Provider\AbstractProvider and implementing requestProfile()) and returns a normalized Digitalway\SocialLogin\Model\Profile.
A custom provider also needs a group with the same code in the digitalway_sociallogin section of system.xml; client_secret must use Magento\Config\Model\Config\Backend\Encrypted.
Set Profile::$emailVerified to true only when the provider guarantees the email is verified: it allows linking to an existing customer with the same email.
Override a button icon in di.xml with the icons argument of Digitalway\SocialLogin\Model\ButtonsProvider: provider code => asset ID (Vendor_Module::images/x.svg) or absolute URL.
A custom provider ships its own icon by implementing Digitalway\SocialLogin\Api\ProviderIconInterface::getIcon(); the di.xml icons argument takes precedence.
A provider is shown only when the module is enabled, the provider is enabled and both client ID and secret are set.
Customers are never linked automatically on an unverified or missing email: the customer completes a form, and an existing account must sign in with its password before the social profile is linked.
Facebook and Instagram use a configurable Graph API version (graph_version, default v24.0) and accept HTTPS redirect URIs only.
Instagram supports Business/Creator accounts only and returns no email.
